name: Parking at Pune metro stations
title: Parking at Pune metro stations: what is built and what is planned
summary: The pay-and-park lots the Pune Municipal Corporation and PMRDA are building near metro stations, for people who drive or ride to the train.
means: Most stations have no parking yet. If you plan to ride or drive to the metro from a home, check whether the nearest station has a lot, or plan a feeder bus or auto.

history.status: PMRDA is seeking land from the corporations for parking lots at eight metro stations.

The Pune Municipal Corporation has built two pay-and-park lots near metro stations, has tenders out for two more, and expects two further sites ready by March. It plans parking across the network of about 81 stations; PMRDA is seeking land for eight more lots.
